channel.title: Rehan Quant Lab - Sovereign Desktop Software Releases

item.title: DocumentShield AI v2.4 Released: Forensic Air-Gapped PDF Redaction
item.description: DocumentShield AI v2.4 brings automated SSN/EIN pattern scrubbing, Bates stamping, and SHA-256 compliance auditing. Benchmark: 1.4s 50-page redaction, 13.8MB RAM, 0 KB network sockets.

item.title: WhisperVault v3.1 Released: 100% Local Voice Transcription Studio
item.description: WhisperVault v3.1 delivers private meeting transcription powered by offline OpenAI Whisper models in Rust. AES-256 encrypted vaults, word-level timestamps, zero cloud audio streaming.

item.title: Retail POS v4.0 Released: Offline Point-of-Sale with SQLite WAL Journaling
item.description: Retail POS v4.0 engineered for physical counters: sub-0.4s barcode scans, ESC/POS thermal printing, crash-proof power-cut recovery, and zero monthly SaaS rental fees.

item.title: TaxLedger v2.2 Released: Offline Double-Entry & GSTR-1 Portal Invoicing
item.description: TaxLedger v2.2 provides standalone Indian financial accounting, GSTR-1 portal JSON exports, and Section 44ADA presumptive tax calculations with zero cloud lock-in.

item.title: Conduit v1.8 Released: Multi-WAN Network Tunnel Bonding & Failover
item.description: Conduit v1.8 bonds cellular, fiber, and Starlink links into a unified virtual socket with sub-10ms packet failover and wire-speed ChaCha20-Poly1305 encryption.
